AggregationType.description: Strategy used to combine a set of health inputs. The service emits documented values; the open string form lets clients retain future named values.

values.name: WorstOf
values.description: Select the greatest-severity member health state, where severity order is Unknown, then Healthy, then Degraded, then Unhealthy.

values.name: BestOf
values.description: Select the least-severe non-Unknown member health state; Unknown is always excluded.

values.name: MinHealthy
values.description: Apply Healthy-count/percentage thresholds over included inputs: at or below the unhealthy threshold yields Unhealthy; otherwise at or below the degraded threshold yields Degraded; otherwise Healthy.

values.name: MaxNotHealthy
values.description: Apply non-Healthy-count/percentage thresholds over included inputs: at or above the unhealthy threshold yields Unhealthy; otherwise at or above the degraded threshold yields Degraded; otherwise Healthy.

AggregationUnit.description: Unit applied to threshold-bearing aggregation strategies. The service emits documented values; the open string form lets clients retain future named values.

values.name: Absolute
values.description: Thresholds are interpreted as absolute counts of included inputs.

values.name: Percentage
values.description: Thresholds are interpreted as percentages of included inputs.

DataAnnotation.description: A data annotation recorded for an entity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the annotation was created (UTC).

description.description: Description of the annotation; omitted when none is recorded.

annotationDetails.description: Additional details for the annotation; omitted when none is recorded.

EntityDiagnosticAggregationConfiguration.description: Aggregation configuration used by diagnostics for a dependency or signal group.

aggregationType.description: Aggregation algorithm used to combine member health states.

degradedThreshold.description: Optional degraded threshold used when the aggregation algorithm supports thresholds.

unhealthyThreshold.description: Optional unhealthy threshold used when the aggregation algorithm supports thresholds.

unit.description: Optional threshold unit used when thresholds are provided.

ignoreUnknown.description: Unknown-input handling flag for threshold strategies: inert for WorstOf, always ignored for BestOf, and for MinHealthy/MaxNotHealthy controls Unknown inclusion in counts/percentages (and their denominator).

EntityDiagnosticAggregationResolution.description: How the effective aggregation configuration was resolved for diagnostics.

values.name: ImplicitDefault
values.description: The service applied an implicit default because no explicit configuration was present.

values.name: Configured
values.description: The service used an explicitly configured aggregation.

values.name: Fallback
values.description: The service used a fallback aggregation because configuration could not be applied directly.

EntityDiagnosticDefaultError.description: Returned when entity diagnostics fail for reasons outside the explicit user-fault contract.

EntityDiagnosticEffectiveAggregation.description: Effective aggregation details applied by the service.

resolution.description: How the effective aggregation was resolved.

EntityDiagnosticHealthInput.description: Name and effective health state of a diagnostic input member.

name.description: Name of the contributing entity or signal.

effectiveHealthState.description: Effective health state contributed by this input.

EntityDiagnosticSignalAggregationGroup.description: Diagnostic details for one signal-aggregation group.

members.description: Configured signal names for this group, preserving names exactly as configured (including spelling and occurrences).

effectiveAggregation.description: Effective aggregation applied to this group.

aggregatedHealthState.description: Aggregated health state produced for this group.

unresolvedMembers.description: Configured signal names that could not be resolved; names are preserved as configured (including spelling and occurrences) and are absent from active signals.

EntityDiagnosticSnapshot.description: Current diagnostic snapshot for an entity.

entityName.description: Name of the entity represented by this diagnostic snapshot.

healthState.description: Current health state of the entity.

lastHealthTransitionAt.description: Timestamp when the current health state became active (UTC), when known.

lastHealthTransitionReason.description: Typed reason for the current health-state transition, when available.

impact.description: Current impact classification of the entity.

signalInputs.description: Signal inputs currently contributing to the entity health evaluation.

dependencyInputs.description: Dependency inputs currently contributing to the entity health evaluation.

effectiveDependencyAggregation.description: Effective dependency aggregation currently applied to dependency inputs.

signalAggregationGroups.description: Signal-aggregation groups considered in the current health evaluation.

EntityHealthStateHistoryPage.description: Health-state periods overlapping the requested window, newest first.

value.description: The health-state periods, ordered newest first.

nextLink.description: The full URI to fetch the next page of results; absent when there is no next page.

EntityHealthStatePeriod.description: A contiguous interval during which the entity held a single health state.

healthState.description: Health state held during this period.

startAt.description:
When this state became active (UTC). Omitted when the state was already active at the
earliest point observable from retained data — i.e. its true start is older than the
~30-day data-retention window, predates the entity's first recorded transition, or lies
beyond the result cap.

endAt.description:
When the entity transitioned away from this state (UTC). Omitted when the state is still
active now (no later transition recorded).

EntityImpact.description: How an entity's health is transformed when propagated to its parent. The service emits documented values; the open string form lets clients retain future named values.

values.name: Standard
values.description: Propagate the entity health state unchanged.

values.name: Limited
values.description: Reduce Degraded to Healthy and Unhealthy to Degraded before propagation; Healthy and Unknown remain unchanged.

values.name: Suppressed
values.description: Propagate Degraded or Unhealthy as Healthy; Healthy and Unknown remain unchanged.

signalName.description: Name of the signal under an entity.

values.name: SignalTransition

values.name: SignalExpiration
values.description: Transition caused by signal expiration.

values.name: SignalDeletion

values.name: ChildEntityTransition

values.name: ChildEntityDeletion
values.description: Transition caused by child-entity deletion.

values.name: DependencyConfigChanged
values.description: Transition caused by dependency aggregation configuration changes.

values.name: SignalAggregationConfigChanged
values.description: Transition caused by signal-aggregation configuration changes.
